attributes.title: 2027 Red Rock CME/CE Conference for PAs
attributes.series: Red Rock CME/CE Conference for PAs
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Red Rock CME/CE Conference, run by the Utah Academy of Physician Assistants with the Nevada academy, moves north to the Utah Valley Convention Center in Provo for March 29 to 31, 2027. It is live only, with no virtual option, and open to PAs, NPs, PA and NP students and other clinicians.

Early-bird pricing runs through November 11, 2026: $350 for UAPA members and $440 for nonmember PAs (membership included), rising to $400 and $490. Students pay $75 and one-day passes cost $225 or $300. The Hyatt Place Provo offers $154 per night with breakfast.

The academy expects about 18.5 credits and will submit the program to AAPA once the agenda is final in November; one line on the same page still says 20.0, so check the final number. Speakers are not announced yet.
